segments.name: Cultured dairy products
segments.description: Lifeway manufactures and markets kefir and other cultured dairy products under the Lifeway, Fresh Made and GlenOaks Farms brands and private labels for U.S. consumers.
segments.evidence: Substantially all our consolidated revenues relate to the sale of cultured dairy products that we produce using the same processes and materials and are sold to consumers through a common network of distributors and retailers in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Lifeway earns revenue by selling its cultured dairy products to retailers and distributors, primarily through retail-direct, distributor, and direct store delivery channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Under the retail-direct channel, we sell our products to retailers and deliver products through either the retailers' carriers or third-party carriers that deliver to such retailers' distribution centers.
